node.description: The node's configuration, including the newly set `run_commit` pin.

guid.title: Guid
guid.description: Unique identifier of the node, matching its directory name.

workflow_guid.title: Workflow Guid
workflow_guid.description: Unique identifier of the workflow the node belongs to.

node_type_id.title: Node Type Id
node_type_id.description: Base runtime type the node runs as (SOURCE_HTTP, SOURCE_CUSTOM, ...). What the runtime builds the node from.

catalog_type_id.title: Catalog Type Id
catalog_type_id.description: Catalog-namespaced identity, when the node was built from a catalog adapter (e.g. LKFHIR_FHIR_PROFILING_TOOLS). What the grid namespaces and locks fields on. Null for bundled/project nodes.

run_commit.title: Run Commit
run_commit.description: Git commit the node is currently pinned to run from, overlaid from the hub's run-pin state (not stored in node_config.json).

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: Whether the node runs on an interval, if applicable.

debug_logging.title: Debug Logging
debug_logging.description: Whether debug logging is enabled for this node.

payload_encryption.title: Payload Encryption
payload_encryption.description: Whether this node encrypts the Kafka payloads it produces (the payload_encryption Node_Policy). Absent/false in node_config.json reads as false.

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Per-node log level gate (ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG). Subsumes debug_logging; log_level=DEBUG is equivalent to debug_logging=true.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable label for this config item.

value.title: Value
value.description: Current value of this config item.

field_type.title: Field Type
field_type.description: UI field type used to render this config item, if specified.

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text description of what this config item controls.

list_options.title: List Options
list_options.description: Allowed choices when this item is a selectable list, if applicable.

field.title: Field
field.description: Name of the other config field this item depends on.

value.title: Value
value.description: Value the referenced field must have for this item to apply.

depends_on.description: Conditional dependency that determines whether this item applies.

value_refs.title: Value Refs
value_refs.description: For a password field, the project variables its saved (encrypted) value references (`${project:<name>}`), so the editor can show them without the value. Null for other fields, or a password with no references.

items.title: NodeConfigItemOut
items.description:
A config item as the grid sends it back: NodeConfigItem plus what the
editor can't work out for itself. Responses only - request models take
NodeConfigItem, which ignores `value_refs`, so it never reaches
node_config.json.

library_deps.title: Library Deps
library_deps.description: Library dependencies for this node, mapping library name to version.

config_version.title: Config Version
config_version.description: Schema version of the node's configuration.

template_origin.title: Template Origin
template_origin.description: Where this node came from, when it was built from a catalog adapter: the catalog and template it follows, the commit its files were written from, whether it still follows that catalog (`linked`), and which of its files the catalog manages. Null for nodes built from a project template, a bundled default, or nothing. See NODE/NODEtemplateOrigin.py.

effective_permissions.title: Effective Permissions
effective_permissions.description: The node's Effective_Permissions, one bool per catalog category, computed from its stored permissions overlaid on the catalog defaults. Null when the Permission_Catalog is invalid (see permissions_error). The raw stored `permissions` section is never echoed back (Req 1.8).

key.title: Key
key.description: Catalog key of the permission category (e.g. 'privileged_apis').

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Human-readable name of the category, shown as the toggle's label.

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text description of what enabling the category permits.

default.title: Default
default.description: The category's default value when the node config does not set it.

permission_categories.title: Permission Categories
permission_categories.description: The Permission_Catalog's categories, so the UI can render one toggle per category. Null when the catalog is invalid (Req 7.7).

permissions_error.title: Permissions Error
permissions_error.description: Present only when the bundled Permission_Catalog is invalid; names the offending entry. When set, effective_permissions and permission_categories are null and the node is treated as having no permissions (Req 7.10).

node.title: NodeConfig

400.description: Commit not found or does not contain this node

404.description: Project, workflow, or node not found

409.description: Node is running; stop it before changing its run commit
